# Perception: Dual Wield
At [bold]10 effective Perception[/bold], you can fire two held guns together. Hold a gun in each hand, enter combat mode, and aim and fire normally. The active gun's fire button controls both guns.
[bold]Both guns must be usable one-handed.[/bold] Weapons that require wielding with two hands cannot be used for dual firing. Mounted and mech weapons are excluded.
Each gun uses its own ammunition, firing mode, and cooldown. Automatic weapons keep firing while you hold the button; semi-automatic weapons fire once per press. Reload each weapon normally. An empty or blocked gun does not stop the other gun from firing.
Releasing fire resets both triggers. Losing the second gun or dropping below 10 Perception immediately removes dual firing; the active gun still works normally.
